Statistics

Choose a dataset, document type, branch or inquiry to see how often each disability or support is mentioned across it. Coverage is still growing as the review backlog is worked through.

Counts reflect automated text-mention detection during document processing, not a clinical judgement that a document is "about" that disability or support -- a document can, and often does, mention more than one, so bars don't add up to the total. A large share of the library hasn't been reviewed yet (see project updates), so these figures will shift as review continues.
